Product Details
90% Silver coins have become a preferred form of investing in Silver. These smaller bags are a great way to accommodate any level of investing in Precious Metals.
Product Highlights:
Contains approximately  7.15  oz actual Silver weight.
Each bag contains only one denomination of Dimes or Quarters (our choice).
All coins are dated 1964 and prior.
These bags are a great way to add more Silver to your portfolio with a single purchase.
Dates and denominations you receive will be of our choosing, determined by stock on hand.
Pre-1964 90% Silver coins, sometimes referred to as junk Silver or scrap Silver, are a great way to start your Silver investments. These Silver coins were pulled from circulation with the introduction of copper/nickel clad coins and the rising demand of Silver. The public saved them for their 90% Silver content as a rainy day fund they can fall back on.
